invariants: wine.name must be unique across all wines in the system
wine.selling_price must be strictly greater than wine.cost_price
wine.primary_storage_location must be exactly one StorageLocation object
storage_location.row_number must be a positive integer
storage_location.shelf_number must be a positive integer
storage_location.max_bottle_capacity must be a positive integer
A StorageLocation cannot be deleted if it has any wines assigned to it
